install_patterns: python3 scripts/cleanup.py (direct script execution from repo root)
risk_notes: Script performs recursive deletions (shutil.rmtree, os.remove) on paths derived from filesystem walks; a misconfigured REPO_ROOT or symlink in tmp/logs could lead to deletion outside the intended scope (though os.path.islink is checked for directories).

Protection list is hardcoded and minimal (.env, database.db, app.py, templates/, static/, .git/); other sensitive files (e.g., docker-compose.yml, secrets/, keys, migrations/) are not protected and could be deleted if they match patterns.

.env backup detection pattern f.startswith('.env.') will match any file beginning with '.env.' including potentially active dotenv variants (e.g., .env.production, .env.local), risking deletion of live configuration/secrets.
